status: Enacted as 2026 Session Laws Chapter 140; section 31 effective 2026-07-01
key_provisions: Section 31 imposes a three-year moratorium, 2026-07-01 through 2029-06-30, on new applications to the state data center tax relief program under A.R.S. 41-1519. It suspends eligibility for the incentive; it does not pause data center construction, siting, or local permitting.

status: Withdrawn from House Commerce Committee, reassigned to AI and Innovation Committee, no further action; died at Sine Die 2026-06-13
key_provisions: Would move the Arizona Commerce Authority certification deadline for new computer data center tax relief applications from 2033 to 2026.

status: Failed House third reading 25-29 on 2026-02-25; reconsideration motion passed 2026-02-26 but no subsequent floor vote recorded; dead at Sine Die 2026-06-13
key_provisions: Would require county comprehensive plans to designate enough land for data centers and small modular reactors so counties do not prevent effective siting.

status: Passed House 32-22 on 2026-03-03; passed Senate committee stages; failed Senate third reading 15-14 on 2026-06-10; died at Sine Die 2026-06-13
key_provisions: Would create a colocation pathway for electric generating facilities serving data centers and other large loads, reducing certificate requirements for qualifying adjacent generation.
